info.title: Doctor's Hub API
info.description: Backend REST API for Doctor's Hub - A platform for searching doctors, hospital and diagnostic facilities, diagnostic tests, booking appointments, and role-based healthcare administration.

get.description: Returns dashboard reference taxonomies, profile details, and role-scoped facilities, doctors, bookings, and tests based on whether the authenticated user is Super Admin, Facility Admin, or Doctor.
Returns a list of all users with the Super Admin role. Accessible only by Super Admins.

post.description: Creates a new super admin user or promotes an existing user account to Super Admin.
post.summary: Create or promote a Platform Super Admin

get.description: Returns all self-registered facilities and doctors awaiting Super Admin verification.
get.summary: List pending facility and doctor verifications

post.description: Allows Super Admin to approve (marking verified and live) or reject (deactivating) a pending registration.
post.summary: Approve or reject a pending facility or doctor verification

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: UUID of the facility location or doctor

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Entity type: 'facility' or 'doctor'

get.description:
ViewSet mixin that narrows querysets based on the authenticated user's role:
- Super admins: full queryset.
- Public catalog endpoints without ?scope=managed: full queryset (enforcement is handled via permission classes).
- Private endpoints (always_scoped=True) or when ?scope=managed is set:
  - Facility admin: filtered to locations in managed_location_ids using `scope_location_field`.
  - Doctor: filtered to user's doctor profile using `scope_doctor_field`.
  - Non-privileged/Anonymous when private scope requested: qs.none().

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.
